title: Container Resource Usage
description: Starter dashboard (#397 follow-on) over cadvisor metrics: per-container CPU/memory for the portal's docker-compose services, broken down by image (each service in this stack runs a distinct image, so this reads the same as "by service"). Grouped by `image` rather than a docker-compose label because cadvisor's containerd fallback path (needed on Docker Engine 28+'s containerd-snapshotter storage backend — see docker-compose.observability.yml) doesn't see Docker Compose's own container labels, only containerd-level ones. Per-container network I/O isn't shown: cadvisor's containerd fallback only reports network stats for the host/root cgroup, not individual containers (confirmed by running the stack, not assumed) — use the Host Overview dashboard's network panel for aggregate throughput instead.
